dct_creator_sm: Jones, Zach (University of Windsor). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0007-4621-5073
dct_description_sm: An acoustic telemetry dataset with code and analysis of tagged smallmouth bass in Smoke Lake, Algonquin Park, Ontario, during three winters. The purpose of this study was to analyze inter-annual variation in overwintering behaviours (depth/temperature occupancy, activity, space use) in relation to temperature conditions.
